label: UEFN MCP (Epic)
description: Official in-editor Unreal MCP (Verse, Scene Graph entities, Creative devices, PIC play sessions). Nested under uefn-ducky — do not add a second IDE mcp.json entry.
requirements_note: Enable the island in Ducky, then open it in UEFN. Default bind http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp.
setup_steps: Enable this island in Ducky. That turns on Python and starts Epic MCP.
Open the project in UEFN (restart once if Epic MCP is still off).
If port 8000 is taken, set Editor Preferences → Model Context Protocol port, then Settings → MCPs unreal-mcp URL to match.
